claimPanels.interpretation: False-discovery panels refer to actual raw failed-check flags and explicit manual positive claims under frozen requirements. Original reviewers also explicitly classify many flags as transport/float/viewport limitations; those qualifiers remain on each claim and in the ledger, and are not separate positive faults. Original U/pass/limitations do not enter positive-claim counts. Repeated diagnostic checks are shown separately; unique detected-cell sets never count repeats.
claimPanels.deduplication: Every actual failed typed row remains preserved and eligible. Original-only versus all-actual panels expose denominator effects of diagnostic reruns.

costs.scope: Continuous endpoints include actual barriers/coordination/cache contention, native commands run one slot per OS per acquisition. Command sums are resource work, not elapsed wall. Shared Mac and one task per arm do not establish causal speed. Generic engineering, common grading, paired captures, publication and CI are experiment work, not treatment development cost. Tokens and monetary cost were not measured.
